Answer: B
Reason: The chest X-ray (Figure 6) shows a small, hypoplastic right lung with opacity and marked dextroposition of the heart and mediastinum toward the right side. This constellation of findings—right lung hypoplasia/aplasia and ipsilateral mediastinal shift—is characteristic of Scimitar syndrome (congenital venolobar syndrome), which is further supported by the CT images showing anomalous venous drainage.
